# Cyber Kings: generic world-struggle triggers. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/struggles/gen_world_struggles.py.
# REGION = the struggle's region, SHARE = a county count (script value)

# An independent, landed ruler whose capital is in $REGION$
ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = {
	is_independent_ruler = yes
	is_landed = yes
	is_landless_adventurer = no
	capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = $REGION$ } }
}

# An independent realm (wherever its capital is) holding at least $SHARE$ counties of $REGION$
ck_struggle_realm_holds_trigger = {
	is_independent_ruler = yes
	is_landed = yes
	any_realm_county = {
		count >= $SHARE$
		title_province = { geographical_region = $REGION$ }
	}
}

# A great power of the world: independent, capital there, empire tier or higher
ck_struggle_great_power_trigger = {
	ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = $REGION$ }
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_empire
}

# No two independent kingdom-tier-or-higher rulers of the world are at war with each other (vanilla truce condition, scaled up)
ck_struggle_general_peace_trigger = {
	NOT = {
		any_independent_ruler = {
			ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = $REGION$ }
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			any_primary_war_enemy = {
				ck_struggle_independent_in_region_trigger = { REGION = $REGION$ }
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			}
		}
	}
}

# Every other great power of the world accepts root: allied, opinion of root >= $OPINION$, or root holds a strong hook on it
ck_struggle_great_powers_accept_trigger = {
	NOT = {
		any_independent_ruler = {
			this != root
			ck_struggle_great_power_trigger = { REGION = $REGION$ }
			save_temporary_scope_as = ck_struggle_other
			NOR = {
				is_allied_to = root
				root = { has_strong_hook = scope:ck_struggle_other }
				opinion = { target = root value >= $OPINION$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

ck_struggle_no_other_great_power_trigger = {
	NOT = {
		any_independent_ruler = {
			this != root
			ck_struggle_great_power_trigger = { REGION = $REGION$ }
		}
	}
}

# The region holds at least $SHARE$ counties of faith $FAITH$
ck_struggle_faith_holds_trigger = {
	any_county_in_region = {
		region = $REGION$
		count >= $SHARE$
		faith = $FAITH$
	}
}
